reader.requirement: At --std 85 a SUM clause with an UPON phrase subtotals its addends only on a GENERATE of a detail report group named in the phrase (once per appearance of the name), a SUM without UPON subtotals on every GENERATE of the report, a GENERATE report-name of a report with one detail counts as a GENERATE of that detail, and an UPON operand that is not a detail of the same report is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 refuses an UPON detail of another report (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2); 2002+ admits the report-name qualifier
DialectLevel < 2002 refuses GENERATE report-name for more than one detail (SR6); the SummaryDetail that carries UPON subtotalling is chosen the same way at every edition
bakes Edition into CobolReport; the SUM accumulation in GenerateCore asks no DialectBehavior

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/IsActive/Edition in ReportSectionBinder, ReportWriterBinder, ReportGroupResolution (none), ReportWriterEmitter and ReportWriter.cs; the GenerateCore SUM loop and SumTerm.Fires consult nothing

reader.notes: SumTerm.Fires returns 1 for no UPON and the count of matching names otherwise; GenerateCore accumulates after control-break processing and before the detail, and BindGenerate hands the sole detail to GenerateSummary so GENERATE report-name subtotals UPON it. GR9c, which states when UPON subtotalling happens, is on a reconstructed folio (PB4952), so the probe expectations lean on GR7, GR8 and GR11a. The refusal diagnostics cite §2023 rules at --std 85 (cosmetic, not this rule).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR1-SR2 and XIII.3.19.4 GR3, GR7, GR8, GR9 (9c reconstructed, PB4952), GR10. Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-148/runs): r1qual-002 (two reports on one FD, both with a detail DA; UPON DA OF RPT1, UPON DA IN RPT2, and one entry with two SUM clauses 'SUM WS-A UPON DA OF RPT1 SUM WS-B UPON DB') printed T1 00012, T2 00112, T3 00005, as expected (each SUM clause's UPON governs only its own addends; GR3 one counter); r1qual-001 (unqualified UPON DA, DA in two reports) refused COBOL1920 ambiguous reference, correct since SR2 lets data-name-1 be qualified by report-name and qualification rules require uniqueness; r2brk-001 (CONTROLS FINAL WS-KEY, UPON DA / UPON DB, scaled S9(3)V9 addends incl. -0.5 and a truncated 2.25) printed CFK 1.5 2.2 at the A->B break (the breaking GENERATE's addend not included, GR7 'after any control break processing but before processing of the detail'), CFK 4.0 -0.5 and CFF SUM KA 5.5, UPON DB 1.7 at TERMINATE, all as expected; r3xrep-001 (UPON DA OF RPT2 in RPT1's footing) refused COBOL2046 citing §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR8  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR7  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2  (3.19.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR3  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'. Grep of DialectLevel in ReportSectionBinder.cs: the other < 2002 arms near the SUM binding (lines 3271, 4178, 4211, 4249) are SR1 addend checks and the GR1 counter size, not the UPON selection.
